name: Fennel Body Lotion Vitamin Series
shortDescription: A 300 ml vitamin-rich body lotion that repairs dry, rough skin and keeps it soft and smooth, in five vitamin formulas.
description:
Fennel Body Lotion Vitamin Series is a 300 ml everyday body lotion that brings deep moisture to dry, rough skin. Each formula is packed with antioxidant vitamins that help skin hold on to moisture and feel noticeably softer and smoother.

The lotion forms a light protective layer against moisture loss and leaves skin comfortable without any greasy feel. With regular use, skin looks healthier and feels smoother, with fine lines appearing softer.

Choose the formula that suits your skin: Vitamin A for fine lines and wrinkles, Vitamin B Complex for a healthy glow and moisture retention, Vitamin C to help repair sun-stressed skin, Vitamin D to replenish moisture and help prevent scarring, and Vitamin E to repair dry, rough skin.

name: Fennel Spotless Brightening Booster Serum
shortDescription: A brightening booster serum that fades dark spots and evens out skin tone for a clearer, more radiant complexion.
description:
Fennel Spotless Brightening Booster Serum is made for skin with dark spots and uneven tone. Its brightening formula, with Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (a stable form of Vitamin C) and Chondrus Crispus (red seaweed) extract, works alongside gentle exfoliating ingredients to target discoloration.

With consistent use, skin looks clearer, smoother and more even, with a healthy glow that comes from within.

Free from parabens, colorants, mineral oils, fragrance, silicones and alcohol.

name: Fennel Loose Rice Powder
shortDescription: A silky loose rice powder with a transparent finish that sets makeup smoothly without settling into fine lines.
description:
Fennel Loose Rice Powder is a finely milled setting powder made with soft silk talc and enriched with essential oil. It gives a transparent, natural finish that keeps skin looking fresh and smooth.

Wear it on its own for a light, even look, or dust it over foundation to set your makeup. It glides on smoothly and does not settle into fine lines.

Available in 10 shades to match a wide range of skin tones.

name: Fennel Aqua Lip Tint
shortDescription: A lightweight, water-based lip tint that adapts to your lips’ natural pH for a custom shade with a fresh, dewy finish.
description:
Fennel Aqua Lip Tint is a light, water-based tint that reacts with your lips’ natural pH to create a shade that is uniquely yours. It gives smart, long-lasting color with dewy care.

The formula is infused with Hyaluronic Acid, Jasmine Rice Extract and Vitamin B3 to hydrate, smooth and nourish lips for a healthy, radiant look. It glides on easily and leaves a fresh, non-sticky finish.

name: Fennel Blush On
shortDescription: A richly pigmented, satiny powder blush that blends evenly for natural-looking, long-wearing color.
description:
Fennel Blush On is a satiny powder blush with deep pigment that builds rich, even color on the cheeks. Its feather-light texture glides on smoothly and blends easily.

It leaves cheeks with a soft, natural flush that lasts throughout the day.

name: Fennel Matte Lipstick
shortDescription: An ultra-creamy matte lipstick with rich, saturated color that stays lightweight, without drying, caking or fading.
description:
Fennel Matte Lipstick delivers bold, saturated color with a beautiful matte finish. Its ultra-creamy texture feels light and comfortable on the lips.

Unlike many matte formulas, it does not leave lips dry, and it will not cake or fade. Choose from 24 shades, from soft nudes and pinks to deep reds and berries.

name: Fennel Volume Express Mascara
shortDescription: An ultra-black volumizing mascara that gives lashes maximum volume and length for a false-lash effect.
description:
Fennel Volume Express Mascara gives lashes maximum volume and length for a striking false-lash look. Its ultra-black, rich color makes the eyes look more defined and expressive.

The elastic formula and comfortable silicone brush coat every lash evenly from root to tip, for extreme black lashes with every stroke.

name: Fennel Lip Balm
shortDescription: A creamy, shiny lip balm with essential oils and vivid flavors that soothes and softens lips.
description:
Fennel Lip Balm has a rich, silky-soft creamy texture that leaves lips with a glossy shine. It is made with essential oils that soothe and care for your lips while giving long-lasting comfort.

Choose from 13 delicious flavors, including Strawberry, Cherry, Peach, Mint, Aloe Vera and Vitamin A&E.

name: Fennel BB Cream SPF 35++
shortDescription: An all-in-one BB cream with SPF 35++ that moisturizes, primes, conceals and covers for a naturally flawless look.
description:

With SPF 35++ sun protection, it is ideal for everyday wear. Available in 6 shades.

name: Fennel Hair Food

It helps restore softness, makes hair easier to manage and gives it a healthy, natural-looking shine.

name: Fennel Anti-Acne Booster Serum
shortDescription: A fast-acting anti-acne serum with Salicylic Acid that clears clogged pores, calms redness and helps prevent breakouts.
description:
Fennel Anti-Acne Booster Serum fights breakouts at the source. Made with Salicylic Acid and Almond Glycerides, its fast-acting formula helps clear clogged pores, calm inflammation and reduce redness.

It soothes irritated skin and helps prevent future blemishes. Lightweight and non-drying, it balances oil production for a clearer, calmer and healthier-looking complexion over time.

Free from parabens, colorants, mineral oils, fragrance, silicones and alcohol.

name: Fennel Melasma Booster Serum
shortDescription: A targeted serum with Niacinamide and Tranexamic Acid that fades melasma, freckles and dark spots for a more even tone.
description:
Fennel Melasma Booster Serum gently fades melasma, freckles and stubborn spots. It is made with Niacinamide and Tranexamic Acid, together with soothing botanicals, to reduce the look of hyperpigmentation.

Gentle enough for daily use, it reveals a more even skin tone and a radiant, visibly clearer complexion with consistent use.

Free from parabens, colorants, mineral oils, fragrance, silicones and alcohol.
